Class PropertyPlaceholderConfigurer

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.core.io.support.PropertiesLoaderSupport
org.springframework.beans.factory.config.PropertyResourceConfigurer
org.springframework.beans.factory.config.PlaceholderConfigurerSupport
org.springframework.beans.factory.config.PropertyPlaceholderConfigurer
All Implemented Interfaces:
Aware, BeanFactoryAware, BeanNameAware, BeanFactoryPostProcessor, Ordered, PriorityOrdered
Direct Known Subclasses:
PreferencesPlaceholderConfigurer
@Deprecated(since="5.2", forRemoval=true) public class PropertyPlaceholderConfigurer extends PlaceholderConfigurerSupport
Deprecated, for removal: This API element is subject to removal in a future version.
自 5.2 版本起，将在 8.0 版本中移除；请使用 org.springframework.context.support.PropertySourcesPlaceholderConfigurer 替代，它通过利用Environment和PropertySource机制而更加灵活。
PlaceholderConfigurerSupport subclass that resolves ${...} placeholders against local properties and/or system properties and environment variables.

PropertyPlaceholderConfigurer 在以下情况仍然适用：

  • `spring-context` 模块不可用（即，使用的是 Spring 的 `BeanFactory` API 而非 `ApplicationContext`）。
  • 现有配置使用了"systemPropertiesMode"和/或"systemPropertiesModeName"属性。鼓励用户不再使用这些设置，而是通过容器的Environment配置属性源搜索顺序；然而，可以通过继续使用PropertyPlaceholderConfigurer来保持功能的精确保留。
Since:
02.10.2003
Author:
Juergen Hoeller, Chris Beams, Sam Brannen

    • setSystemPropertiesMode

      public void setSystemPropertiesMode(int systemPropertiesMode)
      Deprecated, for removal: This API element is subject to removal in a future version.
      Set how to check system properties: as fallback, as override, or never. For example, will resolve ${user.dir} to the "user.dir" system property.

      默认值为 "fallback"：如果无法使用指定的属性解析占位符，将尝试系统属性。"override" 会先检查系统属性，然后再尝试指定的属性。"never" 则完全不检查系统属性。

      See Also:
      • SYSTEM_PROPERTIES_MODE_NEVER
      • SYSTEM_PROPERTIES_MODE_FALLBACK
      • SYSTEM_PROPERTIES_MODE_OVERRIDE
      • setSystemPropertiesModeName(String)

    • setSearchSystemEnvironment

      public void setSearchSystemEnvironment(boolean searchSystemEnvironment)
      Deprecated, for removal: This API element is subject to removal in a future version.
      Set whether to search for a matching system environment variable if no matching system property has been found. Only applied when "systemPropertyMode" is active (i.e. "fallback" or "override"), right after checking JVM system properties.

      默认值为"true"。关闭此设置可防止将占位符解析为系统环境变量。请注意，通常建议通过 JVM 系统属性传递外部值：这可以在启动脚本中轻松实现，即使对于现有的环境变量也是如此。

      See Also:
      • setSystemPropertiesMode(int)
      • System.getProperty(String)
      • System.getenv(String)

    • resolvePlaceholder

      protected @Nullable String resolvePlaceholder(String placeholder, Properties props, int systemPropertiesMode)
      Deprecated, for removal: This API element is subject to removal in a future version.
      Resolve the given placeholder using the given properties, performing a system properties check according to the given mode.

      默认实现会在系统属性检查之前/之后委托给 `resolvePlaceholder(placeholder, props)`。

      子类可以重写此方法以使用自定义解析策略，包括为系统属性检查定制点。

      Parameters:
      placeholder - 要解析的占位符
      props - 此配置器的合并属性
      systemPropertiesMode - 系统属性模式，根据本类中的常量确定。
      Returns:
      解析后的值，若无则为 null
      See Also:
      • setSystemPropertiesMode(int)
      • System.getProperty(String)
      • resolvePlaceholder(String, java.util.Properties)

    • resolvePlaceholder

      protected @Nullable String resolvePlaceholder(String placeholder, Properties props)
      Deprecated, for removal: This API element is subject to removal in a future version.
      Resolve the given placeholder using the given properties. The default implementation simply checks for a corresponding property key.

      子类可以重写此方法以实现自定义的占位符到键的映射或自定义解析策略，可能仅将给定的属性用作回退。

      请注意，无论此方法是在系统属性模式下的调用之前还是之后执行，都会根据系统属性模式检查系统属性。

      Parameters:
      placeholder - 要解析的占位符
      props - 此配置器的合并属性
      Returns:
      解析后的值，若无则为null。
      See Also:
      • setSystemPropertiesMode(int)
